<style>
#ps-login-wrap { display:flex; gap:48px; max-width:960px; margin:0 auto; padding:8px 0 32px; align-items:flex-start; }
.ps-login-main { flex:1 1 460px; max-width:520px; }
.ps-login-side { flex:0 1 320px; background:#F4F8F5; border-radius:12px; padding:28px; }
.ps-login-title { font-size:26px; font-weight:700; color:#222; margin:0 0 8px; text-transform:none; }
.ps-login-sub { color:#555; margin:0 0 22px; }
.ps-label { display:block; font-weight:600; font-size:14px; color:#333; margin-bottom:6px; }
.ps-input { width:100%; padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #D5D5D5; border-radius:8px; font-size:15px; margin-bottom:14px; box-sizing:border-box; }
.ps-input:focus { border-color:#2D5F3F; outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(45,95,63,.12); }
.ps-btn-primary { display:block; width:100%; background:#2D5F3F; color:#fff; border:none; padding:14px 20px; border-radius:8px; font-size:15px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; }
.ps-btn-primary:hover { background:#245033; }
.ps-btn-primary[disabled] { opacity:.6; cursor:default; }
.ps-btn-secondary { background:#fff; color:#2D5F3F; border:2px solid #2D5F3F; padding:12px 20px; border-radius:8px; font-size:15px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; }
.ps-hint { font-size:13px; color:#777; margin-top:12px; }
.ps-magic-done { background:#F4F8F5; border-radius:10px; padding:22px; }
.ps-done-title { font-weight:700; font-size:17px; color:#2D5F3F; margin-bottom:6px; }
.ps-done-sub { color:#444; margin:0 0 10px; }
.ps-link-btn { background:none; border:none; color:#2D5F3F; text-decoration:underline; cursor:pointer; padding:0; font-size:14px; }
.ps-pass-toggle-row { margin-top:26px; padding-top:18px; border-top:1px solid #EBEBEB; }
.ps-pass-box { margin-top:16px; }
.ps-pass-actions { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:14px; margin-top:4px; }
.ps-remember { font-size:14px; color:#555; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
.ps-lost { margin-top:10px; font-size:14px; }
.ps-lost a { color:#2D5F3F; }
.ps-side-title { font-size:17px; font-weight:700; color:#222; margin:0 0 14px; }
.ps-side-list { margin:0 0 16px; padding-left:18px; color:#444; }
.ps-side-list li { margin-bottom:8px; }
.ps-side-note { font-size:13px; color:#777; margin:0; }
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	#ps-login-wrap { flex-direction:column; gap:24px; padding-top:0; }
	.ps-login-main { max-width:100%; }
	.ps-login-side { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; }
}
</style>
